members.name: Francis Brooke
members.background: Joins from Merrill Lynch Investment Managers (1997-2004) where he was a Director with responsibility for managing £1.5 billion of UK equities for major clients. He was a member of MLIM’s Asset Allocation Committee and UK Sector Strategy Group. Prior to that he was a Director of Foreign & Colonial Management Ltd and specialised in UK equity portfolios (1989-97). Francis is a highly experienced investment manager with a distinguished track record and a deep knowledge of equity markets.

extracted_from: Troy Asset Management is delighted to announce the appointment of Francis Brooke... He will be responsible for managing the new Trojan Income Fund due to be launched at the end of September.
extraction_notes: The fund was due to be launched at the end of September 2004, so the start year for the manager is inferred as 2004.
